title: Gilded Plume
html:
Monster drop: The Matriarch

What it’s for

An enchant reagent. Each infuse (one carat more) and each re-enchant to one of these uses one:

  • of the Weasel (gems: Iolite + Emerald + any gem)
  • of Focus (gems: Diamond + Topaz + Topaz)
  • Emerald rings and pendants (their gem: Gem Emerald)

Dropped by Harpy: Fledgling Harpy, Harpy, Harpy Shrieker, Harpy Broodmother, Elder Matriarch, Harpy Matriarch, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Reforging & reagents for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.
